observations.body: The LORD speaks from fire, cloud, and darkness, writes tablets, and hears leaders ask Moses to receive further words; their fear is approved and obedience urged.
observations.label: The assembly hears the voice and asks Moses to mediate

observations.body: The assembly hears the voice and asks Moses to mediate belongs to sinai remembered in the Sinai trail.
observations.label: Where this sits

observations.body: Deuteronomy 5:22–33 supplies later-memory evidence for the event’s developing sequence.
observations.label: Within the Sinai event

observations.body: Later witnesses select and reuse Sinai in their own settings; they remain later readings rather than replacements for the Exodus event.
observations.label: Reading boundary

payload.posture: Read Deuteronomy 5:22–33 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: The assembly hears the voice and asks Moses to mediate belongs to the sinai remembered movement, but its part in the event must remain distinct from the surrounding speech, response, breach, and renewal.
payload.title: The assembly hears the voice and asks Moses to mediate
